story.text:
New Water Source for Chepkongi

The community in Chepkongi now has easy access to clean water and healthcare.

Daily Struggles

In January 2025, life in Chepkongi revolved around long walks for water. The community faced a daily challenge as people trekked seven miles each way to fetch clean water. Their days were consumed by this exhausting routine, leaving little time for farming, education, or family care. The process was not only tiring but also frustrating. Children as well as adults walked this long distance, often in search of the clean water that was so essential for their health and well-being.

The struggle for clean water impacted every aspect of life in the area. Families spent hours each day just to collect the water necessary for daily needs. With limited resources, the difficulty of accessing clean water also hindered the community’s ability to focus on development, as they had to prioritize survival over progress. This lack of essential resources was a constant burden.

The Community's Need

The urgent need for clean water was a pressing issue in Chepkongi. Alongside this, access to adequate healthcare was also limited. The burden of traveling long distances for both water and medical needs compounded the challenges of daily life.

Realizing the need for a solution, community members began to discuss how they could work together to improve their situation. They recognized that while survival was their immediate focus, they needed to create a sustainable future for themselves and their children. A plan began to take shape among the people, who united with the desire to develop their resources and enhance their quality of life. This collective effort set the stage for a significant change in their community.

Working Towards a Solution
